title: CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL – PENDING LITIGATION
text:
[O. Closed Session]
CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL – PENDING LITIGATION
  (Section 54956.9(d)(2),(e)(1) of the California Government Code)

  Discussion regarding significant exposure to litigation (1 potential case).

The Board shall publicly report any action taken in closed session and the vote or
abstention of every member present thereon, in accordance with Section 54957.1 of the
California Government Code.
